title: When I saw you
goal: Say when something happens, with the person, using -DIğIndA, and as soon as with -(I)r -mAz: geldiğimde, gelir gelmez.

intro.text: `-DIğIndA` means **when** and shows the person: *geldiğimde* (when I come or came), *geldiğinde* (when you came, when he came). `-(I)r -mAz` means **as soon as**: *Eve gelir gelmez uyudu* (He fell asleep as soon as he got home).

vocab.en: to get annoyed, to lose your temper

exercises.label: *gelmek* + `-DIğIndA`: when I come, when you come…
exercises.explain: `-DIk` + possessive + *-de*; the third persons add the n of *evinde*: *geldiğinde*, *geldiklerinde*. **You** and **he** share *geldiğinde*.

exercises.question: How do you say **I was very happy when I saw you**?

why.1: *Gördüğünde* is **when you saw** or **when he saw**. For **I**, *gördüğümde*.
why.3: *Görürken* is **while seeing**; the joy came at the moment you saw: *gördüğümde*.

exercises.explain: *gör-düğ-üm-de*: `-DIk` + *-üm* (my) + the locative, **at my seeing**: when I saw.

exercises.en: When I came home, everyone was asleep.

reject.why: The participle is `-DIk`, and its k softens before the vowel: *geldiğimde*.
*Geldiğinde* is **when you** or **when he** came. For **I**, *geldiğimde*.

exercises.explain: *gel-diğ-im-de*: **when I came**. The past continuous *uyuyordu* sets the background.

accept: As soon as I heard the news, I called you.
As soon as I heard the news, I [phoned|rang] you.
The moment I heard the news, I [called|phoned|rang] you.
I [called|phoned|rang] you as soon as I heard the news.
I [called|phoned|rang] you the moment I heard the news.

exercises.explain: *gör-düğ*: `-DIk` with its k softened before a vowel; *-ün*, **your**; then the locative *-de*: **at your seeing**, when you saw.

exercises.en: As soon as the bell rang, I opened the door.
He fell asleep as soon as he got home.
exercises.explain: Positive aorist first, negative second: *gel-ir gel-mez*, **the moment he got home**.

exercises.text: When the exam ended, I felt very relieved.
accept: I felt very relieved when the exam ended.

exercises.prompt: Call me when you get to the hotel.

exercises.en: When I saw you, I got very excited.

exercises.prompt: As soon as the film started, I fell asleep.

exercises.question: *Ali geç kaldığında annesi sinirlenir.* What does it mean?
options: When Ali is late, his mother gets annoyed.
When his mother is late, Ali gets annoyed.
Ali's mother is late because she is annoyed.

why.1: *Kaldığında* goes with *Ali*, the one who is late; *annesi* is the one who *sinirlenir*.

exercises.explain: *Ali geç kal-dığ-ı-n-da*: when Ali is late. The aorist *sinirlenir* makes it a habit.

accept: What did you feel when you saw him?
What did you feel when you saw [her|it]?
When you saw [him|her|it], what did you feel?
How did you feel when you saw [him|her|it]?
When you saw [him|her|it], how did you feel?
